subject.title: fix(codex): fail closed on unknown projector events

question: Should explicit future Codex item status values fail closed as tool failures, accepting that a newly introduced benign status could temporarily appear failed?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility tradeoff: fail-open can report false success, while fail-closed can reject a future non-failure status until the projector is updated.

options.title: Accept fail-closed behavior
options.body: Keep the proposed failure mapping and bounded warning so unknown protocol states cannot silently appear successful.

options.title: Diagnose without changing outcome
options.body: Retain completed projection for unknown values but warn, preserving compatibility at the cost of possible false-success results.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed failure mapping and bounded warning so unknown protocol states cannot silently appear successful.
